licensing.sourceDocuments: Third-party source rights preserved; review stores pointers, fingerprints and original paraphrases.

gapDecision.rationale: Natural-number rounding cannot certify decimal-place rounding; place-value/number-line/fraction conversion does not itself assess selection of a rounded decimal neighbor. Keep both stable goal meanings and mastery unchanged.

requiredRevisions.rationale: Require explicitly nonnegative decimals in this early shared atom. Positive-decimal-only source placements do not justify mandatory negative mastery. Retain signed transfer as a separately reviewed later method, not universal exact J6 coverage.

Do not quietly add decimal subtraction as a hidden mandatory prerequisite for exact-distance justification. Provide distances when used, or assess place-value, adjacent values and decisive digit with a visual explanation. Decimal carry, small zeros and truncation counterexample are suitable.

Actual source rows often contain multiple skills; map only supported scope using reviewed partial source links. HH extracted row contains OCR/table interleaving; base the rounding mapping on actual PDF module5/6 7 positive-decimal context. Preserve TH exact restricted binding document role and original gradebands.
This independent source/semantic review has not inspected a new current native P body, assessment artifact, memory decision or image asset; those remain mandatory before an active808thMath atom.

caseReview.freshTransfer: Pending actual independent task/body review; do not count a plan as evidence.
